work_item: Goal-related bounded candidate selection for ordinary Japanese AskCommonRelations Core route

scope.route: Engine::execute Intent::AskCommonRelations for the ordinary Japanese common-point question
scope.selection: One revision-matched Store relation-index transaction selects exact-scope Fact/Rule records for either named subject and variable-subject Rules through memory_index_common_subject_scope. Selected Facts and Rule premise/additional-premise/conclusion shapes seed the existing per-subject relation proof projection.
scope.ownership: Store supplies revision-checked derived candidates. Existing Core owns candidate interpretation, condition evaluation, proof status, conflict/budget stops, report construction and adoption. No parser grammar, separate decision authority, or external API was added.
scope.budget: Indexed candidate-record selection consumes a bounded portion of request max_actions. The remaining allowance is divided over each candidate shape for both subjects; each existing active_relation_projection and proof query must fit its per-side allowance.
scope.memory_revision: Committed answers and indexed candidate/proof budget stops retain the revision read in the same index transaction on ResultRecord.actor_memory_revision.
scope.index_fallback: A missing/stale index is rebuilt once from the authenticated loaded current snapshot and retried. If a concurrent writer advances the head during rebuild, the immutable loaded snapshot is the bounded request fallback.
scope.recovery: Recovery continues to replay the exact retained CommonRelations memory snapshot and recheck current memory before confirming pending output; this batch does not bound that replay selection.
